structuralSignals.thesis: AMETEK's structural role is diversified mission-critical measurement, inspection, precision-manufacturing and MRO technology embedded in industrial, scientific, medical, aerospace, defense, semiconductor and research workflows; the causal path is human need for reliable/safe/high-precision operation -> infrastructure and production systems -> sensing/measurement/inspection/MRO bottlenecks -> AMETEK instruments, software, components and services.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: American Tower sits between mobile/data demand and scarce physical hosting infrastructure: tower sites enable carrier radio deployment while CoreSite interconnection/data-center assets expose the company to data-intensive workloads. Q2 2026 evidence of robust tower leasing plus record CoreSite leasing supports this dual-infrastructure bridge, but does not establish that either demand stream is permanently scarce.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: ARRAY sits between utility-scale solar module deployment and the physical tracking/control layer: tracker hardware and software improve energy capture, while its installed scale and $2.5B orderbook indicate customers continue to allocate capital to this layer.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: ATI occupies a materials/process bottleneck in aerospace, defense and specialty energy: nickel superalloys, titanium alloys, forgings and advanced powders connect constrained metallurgical capacity to jet engines, airframes and defense systems.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Aurora's causal thesis links autonomous-driving software and sensor/computing integration to a trucking need for safer, more available freight capacity; commercial driverless miles and planned fleet scaling are the bridge from technology to infrastructure utilization.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: AeroVironment now spans uncrewed systems, loitering munitions, counter-UAS, directed energy and adjacent BlueHalo capabilities, linking sensing/autonomy/kinetic and non-kinetic effects to defense demand for distributed, lower-cost mission systems.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: American Water's durable causal chain is regulated capital deployment into water/wastewater infrastructure -> rate-base growth subject to jurisdictional approval -> reliable essential service for households, businesses and military installations; scale and acquisitions can widen the infrastructure base but do not remove regulatory dependence.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Boeing sits on a structurally important commercial-aircraft bottleneck: airline fleet renewal and capacity growth depend on a very small set of large-aircraft OEMs, while Boeing's 6,200-plus commercial-airplane backlog and rising 737 output demonstrate durable demand but make production-system throughput, certification and supplier stability the binding conversion mechanisms.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Bloom Energy occupies a grid-constrained onsite-power pathway for AI/data-center infrastructure: the April 2026 Oracle master agreement supports up to 2.8 GW, with 1.2 GW described as contracted and deploying; this supports a causal link from delayed grid capacity to rapidly deployable onsite fuel-cell demand without treating the 2.8 GW ceiling as contracted backlog.
structuralSignals.falsifier: utility interconnection lead times compress materially or competing onsite architectures consistently beat Bloom on delivered time/cost/reliability

structuralSignals.thesis: Beam's base-editing platform targets disease-causing sequence changes without double-strand DNA breaks; BEAM-302's current AATD path links precision editing to a durable protein-correction need, but the bottleneck shifts from editing capability to pivotal efficacy, long-term safety, regulatory acceptance, manufacturing reliability and commercial delivery.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Bunge's expanded post-Viterra network connects origination, storage, processing and merchandising across agricultural flows; structural value comes from routing optionality and asset density rather than control of an irreplaceable commodity bottleneck.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: BHP links large-scale copper, iron ore and emerging potash supply to electrification/digital infrastructure, steel-intensive development and food security. Copper growth and Jansen diversify the portfolio, but geological endowment is converted into value only through permitting, safe execution, infrastructure and cost discipline.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Booking's structural role is a demand-routing layer between travelers and fragmented travel supply. Property breadth, direct/app traffic, payments, loyalty and Connected Trip can reduce search/coordination friction, but control of traveler discovery is not physically scarce and can migrate to AI agents, search platforms or suppliers.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: BlackSky's structural value proposition is a vertically integrated low-latency geospatial intelligence loop: Gen-3 satellite collection plus analytics converts persistent defense/security monitoring demand into subscription intelligence services; recent pilot-to-multi-year conversion is consistent with that causal path.
structuralSignals.falsifier: Gen-3 pilots fail to convert or subscription utilization/renewals weaken materially

structuralSignals.thesis: Badger Meter's causal role is best represented as measurement/monitoring infrastructure linking water-network physical state to utility operating decisions: smart metering plus sewer-network monitoring can reduce information latency around consumption, leakage and network conditions, but the human-need outcome still depends on utility adoption, workflow integration and maintenance response.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Bitdeer's structural pivot uses controlled power/data-center infrastructure as the scarce input for AI compute, converting an energy-and-site footprint originally optimized for mining into contracted GPU capacity; the fully contracted A102 facility is evidence of demand but not yet proof of realized economics.
structuralSignals.falsifier: energization/GPU deployment delays materially prevent contracted capacity from entering service

structuralSignals.thesis: BWXT sits at a specialized nuclear manufacturing/engineering bottleneck connecting reactor and nuclear-material technologies to defense, energy and isotope infrastructure; recent Army Janus and NNSA design selections indicate transfer of that capability beyond the naval base, while production-scale value remains contingent on follow-on scope and program execution.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Caterpillar links power-generation equipment and industrial machines to the infrastructure needed for compute, construction and resource extraction; the 2-GW AI-power order creates a direct bridge from gas generation to hyperscale compute availability, while the FieldAI collaboration targets the labor/productivity bottleneck through autonomy and physical AI.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Cameco spans multiple nuclear bottlenecks—tier-one uranium production, fuel services and Westinghouse exposure—linking reactor build/life-extension demand to scarce fuel-cycle and reactor-service capacity; increased Cigar Lake ownership deepens control of a high-quality upstream node.
structuralSignals.falsifier: long-term contracting/pricing weakens persistently despite reactor growth

structuralSignals.thesis: Constellation's enlarged nuclear-and-gas generation platform sits directly on the reliable-power bottleneck created by AI/data-center and electrification load growth; Calpine broadens dispatchable capacity while nuclear provides high-capacity-factor clean generation, improving scenario robustness across power-market conditions.
structuralSignals.falsifier: load growth or long-term contracting economics weaken materially

structuralSignals.thesis: Century Aluminum occupies a primary-material bottleneck linking electricity and alumina inputs to domestic aluminum supply used across transport, construction, grid and defense infrastructure; Mt. Holly expansion increases existing U.S. output while the planned Oklahoma smelter would materially expand domestic capacity if financed, built and powered as planned.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.

structuralSignals.thesis: Cognex industrial machine vision sits directly in the factory/warehouse automation loop: sensing and edge inference support inspection, identification and quality/throughput decisions, connecting AI vision technology to manufacturing and distribution efficiency needs.
structuralSignals.falsifier: The cited structural demand path fails to translate into durable company-level economic exposure.
